title: The AI Video Editor Where Humans and AI Agents Create Together
summary: Clueso AI v2 is an AI video editor where you direct and AI agents do the editing, with the best AI models in one place and you in creative control.
body_markdown:
Last month, we announced Clueso's[$10M Series A](https://www.clueso.io/blog/series-a) . Today, we're excited to introduce **Clueso v2** , a major step forward in how businesses create videos.


## You're the creative director now


For years, making a good video meant hours of manual work: trimming clips, nudging text into place, and working through review notes one by one. AI could get you a first draft, but the editing was still on you.


Clueso AI changes that. You decide what the video should be, and Clueso AI does the editing. You can still step into the editor whenever you want to, but most of the time, you won't need to.


**Here's what that looks like**


For example, fixing feedback. Your teammates mark comments right into the video and instead of doing it yourself, you can just ask Clueso AI to address all of them. Clueso makes every edit and replies to each comment with exactly what it changed.


That's one workflow. Here's how our best customers are handing off the rest of their editing:


- **Edit anything by asking:** Generate animations, add transitions, improve pacing, adjust layouts or redesign a whole scene, all with a prompt.
- **Make precise edits:** Click any element to tag it in the prompt box, and describe exactly what should change.
- **Work in parallel:** Apply small edits in bulk across your entire video, or run multiple Clueso AI agents at once to finish several videos faster.
- **Automate entire workflows:** Enterprise teams use Clueprints to automate complex edits, and the Clueso Agent to record product workflows and keep their videos up to date.


Next time you're about to make an edit by hand, ask Clueso AI to do it instead.


## The Best AI Models, All in One Editor


AI models are getting remarkably good at content creation. But no single model or provider is the best at everything.


We've found ElevenLabs best for voiceovers, GPT Sol for scripting, NanoBanana for images, GPT Astra for motion graphics, and Claude for overall orchestration.


Each of these models excels at different creative tasks, and they're improving at an incredible pace. The problem with relying on any single AI assistant (like Claude) is that you're limited to the models and capabilities available within its ecosystem.


**Clueso takes a different approach.**


Rather than tying you to a single provider, Clueso brings the latest open-source and frontier AI models together in one video editor.


You can choose which models to use, or let Clueso automatically route each task to the model best suited for it.


This means you can combine the best scripting model, voice generation model, image model, and animation model within the same video project, without switching between different tools.


The result is higher-quality videos, faster creation, and lower costs. And as new models emerge, Clueso can incorporate them into the workflow, so your video creation capabilities continue to improve alongside AI itself.


## Great Videos Still Need Human Creativity, Taste, and Direction


Despite how powerful AI has become, we don't believe the future of video creation is simply typing a prompt and accepting whatever an AI generates.


Great videos still require creativity, taste, storytelling, and attention to detail. AI can handle the production work, but humans should remain in control of the creative decisions.


That's why Clueso v2 isn't just an AI chat interface that generates videos.


**It's also a fully collaborative video editor where humans and AI agents can work together.** You can edit videos yourself, collaborate with teammates in real time, leave feedback, or ask AI agents to make changes. And whenever you want more control, you can step into the editor and make precise changes yourself.


There's no need to choose between AI generation and manual editing. Both happen in the same workspace. Multiple people and AI agents can contribute to the same video without getting in each other's way.


**AI handles the heavy lifting. You stay in control of the creative decisions.**


We believe this combination of AI automation and human creativity is what will define the next generation of video editing.


## Every Company Is Becoming a Media Company


Today, almost every company needs to create videos.


Marketing teams need product launches, promotional content, and social videos. Sales teams need personalized demos and product explainers. Customer support teams need tutorials and troubleshooting guides. HR and training teams need onboarding videos, employee education, and internal communications.


The demand for video content is growing across every function of a business.


But traditional production workflows simply weren't designed for this scale.


Creating professional videos often requires specialized software, dedicated editors, expensive production resources, and significant time.


We want to change that.


**With Clueso v2, every team in your company can create professional, on-brand videos without needing video editing expertise.**


Getting started with your brand is as simple as dropping your website link into Clueso.


Clueso AI automatically creates your Brand Kit, capturing your visual identity so your teams can produce videos that look and feel consistent with your company.


Whether it's a marketing launch video, a sales demo, or an employee training tutorial, every team can create content that stays true to your brand.


And because AI handles much of the production process, teams can create content consistently and at a scale that would have been difficult with traditional tools.


Our goal is simple: **make it possible for every company to become a media company.**


## Why We Started Clueso


At our previous startup, we spent weeks trying to learn Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. We wanted to create great product videos, but the tools were incredibly complex.


Even relatively simple edits required learning complicated workflows, understanding timelines and keyframes, and spending hours getting everything to look right.


We kept wondering why creating a professional video had to be so difficult.


That frustration eventually led us to start Clueso.


We built Clueso to make traditional, complex video editing tools unnecessary for most business video creation, so anyone could produce great videos without spending weeks mastering editing software.


With advances in AI, that vision is becoming a reality faster than we ever imagined.


Just as AI has become the default way to write code for many developers, we believe it will soon become the default way to edit videos.


The next generation of creators won't need to spend hours manually assembling footage or animating individual elements.


Instead, they'll direct AI agents to bring their ideas to life, stepping in whenever their creativity and judgment are needed.


## We're Just Getting Started


I'm incredibly proud of what our engineering and product teams have accomplished with Clueso v2.


We believe we've built one of the most advanced AI video editing platforms available today.


We're already seeing companies move from tools like Camtasia, Adobe, Canva, and Synthesia to Clueso, bringing video creation, editing, and AI-powered workflows together in one place.
